outcome: Association between IOP and other factors
cohort: Chinese children participating in the Anyang Childhood Eye Study, including 2760 7-year-old children and 2198 12-year-old children
finding: Higher IOP in Chinese children was associated with female gender, older age, thicker central cornea, deeper anterior chamber, and higher mean arterial pressure.
mod_finding: In the older cohort, children born by cesarean section had a higher IOP.
